verdict.rationale: Statsig documents its own Scheduled Rollouts feature, which deploys a Feature Gate gradually over time. That is first-party scheduling of release changes. However, the evidence only describes gradual percentage ramps. It does not show setting a flag change or release to occur at a chosen future date and time, or scheduling other kinds of flag changes. Missing for 10: explicit specific-future-time scheduling, scheduling of arbitrary flag/config changes beyond gradual rollouts, detailed docs on schedule configuration, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can schedule flag changes and releases to happen at a specific future time

citations.quote: Gradually deploy a feature over time by setting up a Feature Gate as a Scheduled Rollout.
Schedule gradual feature rollouts to safely deploy new code
